rule: Client tree = filter(canonical project graph). The filter is code, not a second manual tree.
always_hidden: importance MICRO (focus, error variants, toasts, loading frames, micro-interactions)
shown: SHARED_SYSTEM only when the client needs it to understand the product (e.g. "YOUR ACCOUNT", "PAYMENTS")
labels: Product language only. No routes, state machines, databases, React, APIs. Edge labels are user actions or outcomes.
dependency_language_examples: SETUP → TODAY ("YOU FINISH SETUP, THEN TODAY OPENS")
IDENTITY → FAMILY VISUAL PRODUCTION ("YOUR APPROVED IDENTITY STYLES EVERY SCREEN")
CLIENT APPROVAL → NEXT FAMILY ("WHEN YOU APPROVE, WE START THE NEXT FAMILY")
cost_on_tree: FAMILY nodes may show ESTIMATED / ACTUAL / FUNDING REQUIRED as one small line; detail lives in PROJECT cost center.
founder_override: client_visible and label per node; cannot surface INTERNAL nodes.
founder_tree: Same graph, no filter, plus BROKEN edges, MICRO nodes, route ids, QA status, graph-edit controls (internal only).
